An individual served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a '''military officer''' while simultaneously working to undermine it during the [[Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Internal Affairs" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> data had been discovered which indicated that the treasonous [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was a double [[Agent/Legends|agent]]. The military of one of the two opposing governments in the Cold War wished for the companion of an individual affiliated with their faction to set up a meeting with the officer to determine the truth.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The individual's companion met with the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] officer and gained his confidence to the point that he revealed the details of the work he did to undermine the Sith Empire.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial military officer was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Internal Affairs" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" />
